sites.name: Synthetic Crater & Ridge UV Verification Site
sites.description: Synthetic lunar crater and ridge terrain in Z-up meter coordinates used to verify DemExtent planar UV alignment against an 8x8 checkerboard texture.

sites.name: STL de Shoemaker

Simplicial mesh topology: χ = V(25088) - E(74617) + F(49530) = 1, 1 connected component(s), manifold=true.
